title: 2026 IS YOUR YEAR OF DIVINE TURNAROUNDS
text: If this ministration blesses you, I want you to do something for the kingdom. Share this prayer with somebody. Send it to your family WhatsApp group. Send it to your colleagues. Send it to that person that has been struggling, battling, fighting, and contending. The spirit of God wants to use this as a point of contact for their breakthrough. Don't just receive for yourself. Become a distribution center of the prophetic. When you share the word of the Lord, you activate the law of sewing and reaping in the spirit. Glory to God. Now lift up your hands wherever you are. Whether you're in your room, in your car, in [music] your office, I don't know where this word is meeting you, but I sense very strongly in my spirit that you are a candidate for divine turnaround. The Lord showed me that there are people whose lives are about to shift from one dimension to another. from barness to fruitfulness, from disgrace to honor, from failure to success, from sickness to health, from poverty to abundance. And I have come as an oracle of the most high God to announce to you that this is your season of divine turnaround. When we talk about turnaround, we're not just talking about improvement. Improvement is gradual. Improvement is progressive. But turnaround is sudden. Turnaround is dramatic. Turnaround is when heaven interrupts your story and rewrites your narrative in one moment. The Bible is full of turnaround stories. Esther had a turnaround from orphan to queen. Joseph had a turnaround from prison to palace. Job had a turnaround from aship to double portion. Hannah had a turnaround from barness to motherhood. And I prophesy over your life right now. Your turnaround has located you. Open your mouth and begin to pray in the spirit. Pray in tonesues if you have the gift. If you don't have tongues, pray with understanding. Tell the Lord, "Father, I receive my turnaround. Everything that has been working against my destiny, I command it to expire by fire. Pray aggressively. This is not time for gentle prayers. This is time for violent faith." The Bible says, "The violent take it by force." Open your mouth and pray. You see, there is something I want you to understand about divine turnarounds. They don't come by your wisdom. They don't come by your education. They don't come by your connections. They come by the sovereign intervention of God. When God decides to turn your life around, he doesn't need your permission. He doesn't need your understanding. He just does it. The Bible says in Ecclesiastes 3:1, "He has made everything beautiful in its time." There is a set time for your turnaround. And I decree by the authority of the word of God that your set time has come. Now I want to take you to a very powerful passage of scripture. Open your Bible if you have it with you to the book of Deuteronomy chapter 23:5. The Bible says, "Nevertheless, the Lord thy God will not hearken unto Balam, but the Lord thy God turned the [music] curse into a blessing unto thee, because the Lord thy God loved thee." Glory to God. Did you see that? The Bible says God turned the curse into a blessing. That word turned is very significant. It means that what the enemy meant for evil, God converted it to good. What was supposed to destroy you became the platform for your elevation. What was supposed to kill you became the testimony that advertised God's power. I'm speaking to somebody right now. Everything the enemy has [music] done to you, God is about to turn it around. Every curse that has been speaking over your life, God is converting it into blessing. Every delay that has frustrated you, God is converting it into divine appointment. Every closed door that has discouraged you, God is converting it into [music] supernatural access. This is your year of divine turnaround. Let me tell you something about the nature of God. God specializes in turnarounds. When you study the character and the nature of Jehovah, you will discover that he loves to take impossible situations and turn them around. He took the Red Sea that was supposed to drown Israel and turned it into a part of deliverance. He took the lion's den that was supposed to kill Daniel and turned it into a place of promotion. He took the fiery furnace that was supposed to consume the Hebrew boys and turned it into a place of divine visitation. He took the cross that was supposed to be the end of Jesus and turned it into the beginning of salvation for all mankind. So when you bring your situation to God, don't tell him it's too complicated. Don't tell him it's too late. Don't tell him it's impossible. Because the God we serve is the God of turnarounds. He's the God who makes a way where there is no way. He's the God who speaks to dead situations and they come back to life. He's the God who can take your mess and turn it into a message. He can take your test and turn it into a testimony. He can take your pain and turn it into purpose. I want you to lift up your voice right now and prophesy to your situation. Tell that sickness, "My body is turning around to health." Tell that business, "You are turning around to profitability." Tell that ministry, "You are turning around to fruitfulness." Tell that marriage, you are turning around to peace and joy. Tell that situation you are turning around for my good in Jesus name. Open your mouth and declare it. The Bible says life and death are in the power of the tongue. You have the authority to prophesy your turnaround. Now there are certain principles that govern divine turnarounds and the spirit of God is leading [music] me to share these principles with you because when you understand how turnarounds work in the spirit, you can position yourself [music] to receive yours. The first thing you need to understand is this. Divine turnarounds are preceded by divine encounters. Before your life can turn around, you must have an encounter with God. Not just church attendance, not just religious activity, but a genuine encounter with the presence of God. Look at the life of Jacob. For 20 years, Jacob was running from his past. He was running from Esau. He was running from his destiny. But one night at a place called Pineal, Jacob had a wrestling encounter with God. And the Bible says when the day broke, Jacob was limping, but his life had turned around. His name was changed from Jacob the suppler to Israel the prince. His identity was transformed. His destiny was activated. And that's exactly what God wants to do for you. The Lord is asking me to tell you, some of you need to pursue a fresh encounter with God. You've been going through the motions of religion, but you haven't had a life-changing encounter with his presence. You need to create time to seek his face. You need to create space to hear his voice. You need to position yourself for a divine encounter because when you encounter God, everything about your life will turn around. Moses had an encounter at the burning bush and his life turned from a shepherd to a deliverer. Saul had an encounter on the road to Damascus and his life turned from a persecutor to an apostle. Mary had an encounter with an angel and her life turned from an ordinary virgin to the mother of the Messiah. Peter had an encounter at the Sea of Tiberius after the resurrection and his life turned from a denier to a world changer. I'm prophesying to you right now in this year. You will encounter God in a way you have never encountered him before. And when you encounter him, your turnaround will be activated. Every limitation will break, every barrier will crumble, every opposition will collapse, [music] and you will walk into the fullness of what God has prepared for you. Now, the second principle is this. Divine turnarounds require divine alignment. You cannot have a turnaround while you are out of alignment with God's will. Many people are praying for breakthrough, but they living in disobedience. They want God to bless their plans, but they have not submitted their plans to God's purpose. Listen to me very carefully. Turn around comes when you align your will with God's will. The Bible says in Proverbs 3:5 and 6, "Trust in the Lord with all thine heart and lean not onto thine own understanding. In all thy ways acknowledge him, and he shall direct thy paths." [music] When you acknowledge God in all your ways, when you submit your plans to his purpose, when you align your life with his word, then he takes responsibility for turning your life around. Some of you have been struggling because you've been trying to do things your own way. You've been following your own wisdom. You've been leaning on your own understanding. And God is saying, "If you will trust me, if you will surrender to me, if you will align yourself with my will, I will turn your life around." Stop fighting God. Stop resisting his plan. Surrender to his [music] purpose and watch him do what only he can do. The third principle is this. Divine turnarounds are activated by divine timing. You see, God operates by times and seasons. The Bible says in Ecclesiastes 3:1, "To everything there is a season and a time to every purpose under the heaven. There is a time to sow and a time to reap. There is a time to weep and a time to laugh. There is a time to mourn and a time to dance. And I'm here to announce to you that your time of turnaround has come. Some of you have been waiting for years. You've been believing God. You've been standing on his promises. You've been faithful in prayer and in the word. And it seems like nothing is happening. But I want you to know that in the realm of the spirit, God has been working behind the scenes. He has been arranging things. He has been positioning people. He has been orchestrating events. And suddenly in this season, everything is going to come together for your turnaround. The Bible says in Habacook 2:3, "For the vision is yet for an appointed time, but at the end it shall speak and not lie. Do it tar. Wait for it because it will surely come. It will not tar." Your turnaround has an appointed time. And I prophesy that your appointed time is now. What has been delayed is about to manifest. What has been postponed is about to materialize. What has been suspended is about to be released. Open your mouth right now and thank God for divine timing. Tell him, "Father, I thank you that my turnaround is not late. I thank you that you are never late. I thank you that you are always on time. I thank you that what you have promised, you are able to perform. Begin to worship him. begin to magnify [music] him because when you worship God in advance of your turn around you are demonstrating faith and without faith it is impossible to please God. Now let me show you something very powerful. When God is about to turn your life around the enemy will intensify his attack. When God is about to promote you the devil will try to discourage you. When God is about to bless you Satan will try to distract you. When God is about to elevate you, the adversary will try to intimidate you. So if you have been facing unusual opposition lately, if you have been experiencing severe attacks, if you have been going through intense warfare, don't be discouraged. That's a sign that your turnaround is near. The Bible tells us in the book of Exodus that when God was about to deliver Israel from Egypt, Pharaoh made their bondage heavier. He increased their suffering. He intensified their oppression. But that was not a sign that God had forgotten them. That was a sign that their deliverance was at the door. And within a few days, they walked out of Egypt with silver and gold, with signs and wonders, with mighty miracles. So whatever the enemy is throwing at you right now, I want you to know that is a sign of your impending turnaround. The devil knows that if you break through, you will become dangerous. If you receive your turnaround, you will be unstoppable. If you walk into your destiny, you will wreck havoc on his kingdom. That's why he's fighting you so hard. But I have good news for you. The battle is already won. Jesus has already defeated the devil. And by the authority of the finished work of Christ, your turnaround is guaranteed. Let me pray a prayer of activation over your life right now. And as I pray, I want you to receive this prayer in faith. Lift up your hands, open your spirit, and believe God for a supernatural turnaround. Father, I thank you for everyone that is listening to this ministration. I thank you for the word that you have given. And now, Lord, I ask that you will activate turnarounds in their lives by the power of the Holy Ghost. Every delay, I command it to expire right now in the name of Jesus. Every opposition, I command it to collapse by fire. Every barrier I command it to crumble by the authority of the word of God. I speak to barren wombs right now. Conceive in the name of Jesus. I speak to stagnant businesses experience supernatural growth in the name of Jesus. I speak to delayed marriages. Receive divine connections in the name of Jesus. I speak to frustrated careers turn around by the power of God in the name of Jesus. I speak to every hopeless situation receive hope in the name of Jesus. Father, let your turnaround anointing fall upon them. Let the same spirit that turn water into wine turn their situations around. Let the same power that turned the Red Sea into a highway turn their impossibilities into possibilities. Let the same grace that turned Saul into Paul turn their weaknesses into strength. In the mighty name of Jesus Christ, I decree and declare turnaround is their aortion. Amen. Now, I want to show you something else that is very important. When God turns your life around, he doesn't just change your circumstances. He changes your identity. He changes how you see yourself. He changes how others see you. He changes your [music] status in the realm of the spirit. The turnaround is not just external. It's also internal. It's not just about what happens around you. is about what happens inside you. Look at the story of Joseph. When Joseph was in prison, he was known as a prisoner. He was known as a slave. He was known as a criminal. That was his identity. That was his status. But in one day, God turned his life around. Pharaoh called for him. And within hours, Joseph went from the prison to the palace. His clothes were changed. His position was changed. His authority was changed. And most importantly, his identity was changed. He was no longer Joseph the prisoner. He was now Joseph the prime minister. He was now Joseph the deliverer. He was now Joseph the preserver of nations. That's what God wants to do for you this year. He wants to change your identity. He wants to change how you see yourself. Some of you have been seeing yourself as a failure, but God is about to turn you around and you will see yourself as successful. Some of you have been seeing yourself as rejected, but God is about to turn you around and you will see yourself as accepted in the beloved. Some of you have been seeing yourself as limited, but God is about to turn you around, and you will [music] see yourself as more than a conqueror. The Bible says in 2 Corinthians 5:17, "Therefore, if any man be in Christ, he's a new creature. Old things are passed away. Behold, all things have become new. When God turns your life around, he makes all things new. Your old identity passes away. Your old limitations pass [music] away. Your old struggles pass away, and you become a new creation with a new identity, a new authority, and a [music] new destiny. I'm speaking prophetically to somebody right now. The name that people have been calling you is about to change. The reputation that has been following you is about to change. The story that has been told about you is about to change. Because when God turns your life around, he gives you a new name. He gave Abraham a new name, Abraham. He gave Sarai a new name, Sarah. He gave Jacob a new name, Israel. He gave Simon a new name, Peter. And he's about to give you a new name. Now, I want to talk to you about the cost of turnaround. Because while turnaround is a gift of God's grace, there is a price to pay to maintain it. When God turns your life around, you must guard what he has given you. You must [music] protect what he has done for you. You must steward the new season that you have entered. The Bible tells us about the children of Israel. God turned their lives around. He delivered them from Egypt. He brought them out of bondage. He performed miracles for them. But because they didn't guard their deliverance because they kept complaining, because they kept looking back, many of them never entered the promised land. They received turnaround from Egypt, but they didn't maintain it all the way to Canaan. So I want to warn you today, when God turns your life around, don't go back to the same habits that kept you in bondage. Don't go back to the same associations that hindered your progress. Don't go back to the same mindset that limited your potential. Guard your turnaround with prayer. Guard your turnaround with the word. Guard your turnaround with worship. Guard your turnaround with obedience. The Bible says in Proverbs 4:23, "Keep thy heart with all diligence. For out of it are the issues of life. When God turns your life around, you must guard your heart. You must guard your mind. You must guard your spirit. [music] Because the enemy will try to steal what God has given you. He will try to reverse what God has done for you. But if you remain vigilant, if you remain prayerful, if you remain obedient, your turnaround will be permanent. Now, let me share with you testimonies of turnaround from the scriptures. Because when you hear what God has done for others, faith will rise in your heart for what he can do for you. Let's look at the woman with the issue of blood in Mark chapter 5. This woman had been bleeding for 12 years. She had spent all her money on doctors. She was getting worse instead [music] of better. She was ceremonially unclean. She was socially isolated. She was physically weak. She was emotionally broken. Everything about her life was in decline. But one day she heard about Jesus and faith rose in her heart. She said to herself, "If I may but touch his garment, I shall behold." So she pressed through the crowd. She fought past the obstacles. She ignored the voices that told her to give up. And she touched the hem of his garment. And immediately her turn around happened. The bleeding stopped. The weakness [music] left. The shame was removed. And Jesus said to her, "Daughter, thy faith hath made thee whole." I'm prophesying to somebody right now. Your turnaround is one touch away. Your breakthrough is one encounter away. Your miracle is one moment of faith away. Don't give up now. Don't quit now. Press through, push forward, reach out by faith and touch the master. And when you touch him, everything about your life will turn around. Let me show you another example. The Bible tells us about blind Batimos in Mark chapter 10. This man was sitting by the roadside begging. He was blind. He was poor. He was helpless. He was dependent on the mercy of others. Day after day, he sat in the same spot crying for help. His life seemed hopeless. His future seemed dark. But one day he heard that Jesus was passing by. And something happened in his spirit. Instead of sitting quietly like he always did, he began to cry out, "Jesus, thou son of David, have mercy on me." The crowd tried to silence him. They told him to be quiet, but he cried out even louder. "Thou son of David, have mercy on me." And Jesus stood still. Jesus called him. And Jesus asked him, "What wil thou that I should do unto thee?" And Batameus said, "Lord, that I might receive my sight." And Jesus said to him, "Go thy way. Thy faith hath made thee whole." And immediately Batameus received his sight. His turnaround happened in an instant, from blindness to sight, from begging to seeing, from dependence to independence. His life was completely transformed. I want you to do what Batimos did right now. I want you to cry out [music] to Jesus. Don't be quiet. Don't be polite. Don't be religious. Cry out from the depths of your spirit. Tell him, "Lord Jesus, have mercy on me. Turn my life around. Change my story. Transform my situation." When you cry out to him with all your heart, he will stop for you. He will answer you and he will turn your life around. Let me show you one more powerful example. The Bible tells us about Naomi in the book of Ruth. Naomi's life had completely fallen apart. Her husband died. Her two sons died. She lost everything. She was so broken that she changed her name from Naomi, which means pleasant, to Mara, which means bitter. She said, "Call me not Naomi, call me Mara." For the Almighty had dealt very bitterly with me. But God was not finished with Naomi's story. Through Ruth's faithfulness, through Boaz's kindness, [music] through divine providence, God turned Naomi's life around. She went from bitterness to joy. She went from loss [music] to restoration. She went from emptiness to fullness. And at the end of her story, the Bible says, "The [music] women of the city said to her, "Blessed be the Lord, which had not left it this day without a king's man, that his name may be famous in Israel." So if your life feels bitter right now, if everything seems to have fallen apart, if you've lost what was precious to you, I want you to know that God is not finished with your story. He's the God of turnarounds. He's the God of restoration. He's the God of redemption and what he did for Naomi, he will do for you. Now, I want to pray some very specific prayers over your life. These are militant prayers. These are warfare prayers. These are prayers that will break every force that has been resisting your turnaround. As I pray, I want you to agree with me in faith. Say amen out loud. Let your agreement activate these prayers in the realm of the spirit. Every satanic agent that has been assigned to monitor your life and report your movements to the kingdom of darkness, I command you to catch fire and burn to ashes in the name of Jesus. Every witchcraft power that has been manipulating your destiny and preventing your progress, [music] I command the judgment of God to fall upon you now in the name of Jesus. Every familiar spirit that has been following your family line and perpetuating [music] cycles of failure, I command you to be bound and cast into the abyss in the name of Jesus. Every evil altar where your name is being mentioned, every satanic covenant that was entered into on your behalf, every demonic dedication that [music] was made over your life, I destroy you by fire in the name of Jesus. Every evil pronouncement that was spoken over you as a child, every negative prophecy that was declared over your destiny, every word that has been limiting your potential, I nullify you [music] by the blood of Jesus. I cancel you by the authority of the word of God. I render you powerless in the mighty name of Jesus Christ. Every spirit of delay, I bind you. Every spirit of frustration, I cast you out. Every spirit of confusion, I rebuke you. Every spirit of stagnation, I destroy your power. Every spirit of poverty, I break your hold. Every spirit of sickness, I command you to leave. Every spirit of barrenness, I command you to release your captives. In the name of Jesus, I decree that every demonic force that has been working against your [music] turnaround is destroyed right now. Father, I ask that you will release your angels on assignment for turnaround. Let the angel of blessing locate them. Let the angel of breakthrough fight [music] for them. Let the angel of divine connection bring the right people into their lives. Let the angel of multiplication touch their finances. Let the angel of healing touch their bodies. Let the angel of restoration repair what has been broken in the mighty name of Jesus. Let heaven be activated on their behalf. I speak to every closed door opened by fire in the name of Jesus. I speak to every blocked opportunity be unblocked by the power of God in the name of Jesus. I speak to every delayed blessing be released now in the name of Jesus. I speak to every stolen virtue be restored sevenfold in the name of Jesus. I speak to every wasted year. Receive divine compensation in the name of Jesus. Now begin to thank God for your turn around. Begin to praise him as if it has already happened. Begin to worship him as if you've already received it. Because in the realm of the spirit, it is already done. Your turnaround is not coming. It is here. Your breakthrough is not future. It is now. Your miracle is not tomorrow. [music] It is today. The Bible says in Hebrews 11:1, "Now faith is the substance [music] of things hoped for, the evidence of things not seen." Faith calls those things that be not as though they were. So start thanking God now. Start praising him now. Start declaring it now. Say, "Thank you, Lord, for turning my life around. Thank you for changing my story. Thank you for transforming my situation. Thank you for the turnaround that is manifesting in my life right now. I see it in the spirit. I see doors opening. I see opportunities coming. I see divine connections being made. I see financial breakthroughs manifesting. I see healing flowing. I see marriages being restored. I see businesses [music] prospering. I see ministries expanding. I see students excelling. I see lost ones returning. I see captives being set free. This is your year of divine turnarounds. There's something else the Lord wants me to tell you. When your turnaround comes, it will not just affect you. It will affect your family. It will affect your generation. It will affect your sphere of influence. The turnaround that God is bringing into your life is not just for your benefit. It's for the benefit of everyone connected to you. Look at Job. When God turned Job's life around, the Bible says in Job chapter 42:10, "And the Lord turned the captivity of Job when he prayed for his friends." Also, the Lord gave Job twice as much as he had before. Notice that Job's turnaround came when he prayed for his friends, when he interceded for others, when he blessed those who had hurt him. And when his turnaround came, it was double. God didn't just restore what he lost. God gave him twice as much. I'm prophesying that your turnaround will be double. God is not just going to restore what the enemy stole from you. He's going to give you double for your trouble. He's going to give you beauty for ashes. He's going to give you joy for mourning. He's going to give you the oil of gladness for the spirit of heaviness. Your latter end will be greater than your beginning. But I want you to understand something. If you want your turnaround to be complete, you must be willing to forgive those who have hurt you. You must be willing to pray for those who have wronged you. You must be willing to bless those who have caused you because unforgiveness [music] will block your turnaround. Bitterness will hinder your breakthrough. Resentment will limit your restoration. Jesus said in Mark 11:25, "And when ye stand praying, forgive if ye have ought against any, that your father also which is in heaven may forgive you your trespasses." Before you can receive turnaround, you must release forgiveness. Before God can turn your situation [music] around, you must turn your heart around from bitterness to blessing. So right now, I want you to do something. Think about anyone who has hurt you. Anyone who has betrayed you, anyone who has disappointed you, anyone who has wronged you, and I [music] want you to make a decision to forgive them, release them. Let them go. Don't carry that burden anymore. Don't hold that grudge anymore. Forgive them not because they deserve it, but because you deserve to be free. Say this prayer with me. Father, I choose to forgive everyone who has hurt me. I release them from my judgment. I release them from my bitterness. I release them from my resentment. And I ask you to bless them, help them, and save them. Lord, cleanse my heart of all unforgiveness. Heal my heart of all wounds. And now turn my life around for your glory in Jesus name. Amen. Now that you are forgiven, you have cleared the path for your turnaround. You have removed the obstacle. You have opened the door. And I decree that from this moment forward, your life will never be the same. The turnaround has begun. Let me tell you what to expect in [music] your year of turnaround. First, expect supernatural acceleration. Things that were taking years will happen in months. Things that were taking months will happen in weeks. Things that were taking weeks will happen in days. God is going to compress time on your behalf. He's going to speed up your progress. He's going to accelerate your breakthrough. The Bible tells us in Isaiah 60:22, "A little one shall become a thousand and a small one, a strong nation. I the Lord will hasten it in his time." When God is ready to turn your life around, he will hasten it. He will [music] speed it up. He will make it happen quickly. So don't be surprised if things start moving fast. Don't be surprised if doors start opening rapidly. Don't be surprised if opportunities start coming suddenly. That's the acceleration of divine turnaround. Second, expect supernatural favor. The Bible says in Psalms 5:12, "For thou Lord will bless the righteous. With favor will thou compass [music] him as with a shield." God is going to surround you with favor this year. Everywhere you go, you will find favor. With everyone you meet, you will receive favor. In every situation you face, favor will work for you. Favor will open doors that qualifications cannot open. Favor will take you places that money cannot take you. Favor will connect you with people that networking cannot connect you with. Favor will give you opportunities that merit alone cannot give you. And I decree that uncommon favor is your portion in this year of turnaround. Third, expect supernatural provision. God is going to provide for you in ways that you cannot explain. He's going to meet needs that you haven't even mentioned. He's going to supply resources that you didn't know existed. He's going to open sources of income that you never imagined. And you will testify that Jehovah Gyra, the Lord who provides, [music] has turned your financial situation around. The Bible says in Philippians 4:1 19, "But my God shall supply all your need according to his riches in glory by Christ Jesus." Notice, it doesn't say according to your bank account. It doesn't say according to your job. It doesn't say according to the economy. It says according to his riches in glory. God has unlimited resources and in your year of turnaround, he's going to tap into those resources on your behalf. Fourth, expect supernatural restoration. Everything the enemy has stolen from you, God is going to restore it. Every year that the cankerworm has eaten, God is going to give it back. Every blessing that was delayed, God is going to release it. Every opportunity that was missed, God is going to recreate it, and you will walk in the fullness of restoration. The Bible says in Joel 2:2, "And I will restore to you the years that the locust had eaten the canker worm and the caterpillar and the palmer worm, my great army which I sent [music] among you." God is a restorer. He restores broken hearts. He restores broken homes. He restores broken dreams. He restores broken bodies. He restores broken finances. Whatever has been broken in your life, God is restoring it in your year of turnaround. Let me close this ministration with a final prophetic declaration over your life. I want you to receive this word as a final seal on everything we've ministered today. Stand up if you can, lift up your hands, open your heart, and receive this word as the oracle of the Lord. I decree over your life that from today, your story has changed. You will no longer be known by your past. You will be known by your future. You will no longer be identified by your struggles. You will be identified by your victories. You will no longer be defined by your limitations. You will be defined by your possibilities. I prophesy that this year you will experience turnarounds that will make you a reference point in your generation. Your testimony will inspire [music] others. Your breakthrough will encourage the discouraged. Your miracle will build faith in the faithless and men will know that the Lord has done [music] great things for you. I decree that every satanic agenda for your life is canceled. Every demonic project against your destiny is destroyed. Every witchcraft manipulation over your progress is nullified. And you are free to walk in the fullness of what God has ordained for you. I declare that you are coming out of obscurity into visibility. You are coming out of the background into the forefront. You are coming out of the valley into the mountain. You are coming out of the wilderness into the promised land. This is your season of emergence. This is your season of manifestation. This is your season of divine turnaround. The Lord says to you today, I am turning your mourning into dancing. I am turning your weeping into laughter. I am turning your sorrow into joy. I am turning your weakness into strength. I am turning your failure into success. I am turning your lack into abundance. I am turning your sickness into health. I am turning your barness into fruitfulness. The Lord says, "What I am doing for you this year will shock your enemies. It will silence your critics. It will amaze your friends. It will bless your family. And it will glorify my name. I seal this word over your life in the mighty name of Jesus Christ. Your turnaround is permanent. Your breakthrough is irreversible. Your elevation is unstoppable. [music] And your destiny is secured. Now go forth in faith. Walk in confidence. Live in expectation because this is your year of divine turnarounds. Shout hallelujah. Give God the highest praise. Your turnaround has come in Jesus mighty name. Amen. And amen.
